title: Artifact Reference
description: A reference to a versioned artifact (dataset, model, report) stored externally.

manifestHash.description: Content hash of the artifact manifest for integrity verification.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the schema the artifact conforms to.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the artifact in bytes.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the artifact (e.g. application/parquet, application/json).
